Exquisite 4-Bedroom Semi-Detached Villa with Private Pool & Lift | Bay Villas, Dubai Islands

Provident Real Estate is excited to showcase this stunning 4-bedroom semi-detached villa nestled within the prestigious Bay Villas community on the breathtaking Dubai Islands. Combining luxury, privacy, and impeccable design, this residence is perfect for those seeking an elevated beachfront lifestyle.

This impressive G+2 villa boasts a private rooftop terrace, private swimming pool, and private lift, complemented by extra parking spaces conveniently located beside the villa. Situated just a minute’s walk from the beach and exclusive beach club, this home offers seamless access to leisure and relaxation.

Property Features:

4 En-suite Bedrooms with Walk-in Closets
Semi-Detached Layout
Private Swimming Pool
Private Lift (Elevator)
G+2 Layout with Rooftop Terrace
Double-Height Entrance Lobby
Covered Garage + Extra Parking Adjacent to Villa
Dedicated Pets Zone
Spacious Open-Plan Living and Dining Area
Contemporary Kitchen with Premium Finishes
1 Minute Walk to Beach and Beach Club

Bay Villas offers a serene waterfront lifestyle, with access to exclusive community amenities and easy connectivity to Dubai’s top destinations—all while surrounded by the natural beauty of Dubai Islands.

This is beachfront luxury redefined—perfect for families, or investors seeking long-term value in a prestigious location.
